articles.summary: State-of-the-art convening space will connect the public to thought leaders in science, technology and innovation at one of New England’s most attended cultural institutions Eastern Bank is pleased to announce tax-exempt bond financing for the William and Charlotte Bloomberg Public Science Common at the Museum of Science in Boston, a new 10,000-square foot civic venue designed to inspire lifelong engagement with science by sparking discourse and discovery through immersive experiences. With floor-to-ceiling glass overlooking the Charles River and 270-degree views of the Boston skyline, the William and Charlotte Bloomberg Public Science Common complements its civic mission with state-of-the-art immersive media, production, and livestreaming technology that enables events to reach audiences around the world. Eastern, as the sole lender, is providing a tax-exempt bond to support the project. “The William and Charlotte Bloomberg Public Science Common and its plan to serve as a public
articles.title: Eastern Bank Provides Tax-Exempt Bond Financing For the William and Charlotte Bloomberg Public Science Common at the Museum of Science

articles.summary: Board thanks Deborah C. Jackson for her service as Lead Director, and announces the retirement of Chair Emeritus Richard E. Holbrook and the resignation of Director Luis A. Borgen Eastern Bankshares, Inc. (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: EBC), the holding company of Eastern Bank, today announced its Board of Directors (the “Board”) has unanimously elected Peter K. Markell as Lead Independent Director, effective January 1, 2027. Mr. Markell will succeed Deborah C. Jackson, who will step down as Lead Director effective January 1, 2027, in anticipation of her planned retirement from the Board at year-end 2027. The Company also announced Director and Chair Emeritus Richard E. Holbrook will retire from the Board effective December 31, 2026 in accordance with the mandatory age limitations for members of the Board set forth in the Company’s Corporate Governance Guidelines, and Luis A. Borgen will resign from the Board effective December 31, 2026 to devote more time to his personal and professional
articles.title: Eastern Bankshares, Inc. Announces Board Leadership Transition; Peter K. Markell Elected Lead Independent Director

articles.summary: Provides comprehensive financing solution for working capital and business growth strategy Eastern Bank is pleased to announce NE Landscape Holding (NELH), a full-service provider of landscaping services throughout Massachusetts and southern New Hampshire, as a new commercial banking customer. Founded by Anvil Capital, NELH acquires and grows leading landscaping service providers throughout New England. Its portfolio includes Leahy Landscaping and Lynch Landscape Tree Service as well as the recently acquired Comak Brothers Landscaping, which provide commercial, municipal, and residential landscaping, tree care, composting, snow removal, and irrigation services. Eastern provided a credit package to refinance existing debt and support ongoing working capital, which includes a delayed draw facility to finance the acquisition of Comak Brothers Landscaping and regional expansion. “We’re pleased to welcome NE Landscape Holding to Eastern,” said Greg Buscone, Executive Vice President
articles.title: Eastern Bank Announces NE Landscape Holding As A Commercial Banking Customer

articles.summary: Eastern Bank has been named by the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) as the top lender to small businesses for SBA 7(a) loans in Massachusetts for the 18 th consecutive year. “Eighteen years in a row demonstrates the enduring commitment of small business owners advancing businesses every day in neighborhoods from the Merrimack Valley and North Shore, to Greater Boston, the Cape, South Shore and beyond, and our team of bankers and colleagues who are deeply committed to understanding their needs and helping to turn them into thriving businesses,” said Quincy Miller, Vice Chair, President and Chief Operating Officer of Eastern Bank. “We are grateful to work alongside the SBA and many community organizations to support small businesses across Massachusetts, and proud to offer our support in New Hampshire and Rhode Island where Eastern also ranks among the top 10 SBA lenders. Helping local entrepreneurs access the resources to help their businesses succeed is core to our mission as
articles.title: Eastern Bank Named #1 SBA Lender in Massachusetts for the 18th Year in a Row
